notes: Round 59. BOL refused for the second time: the only ownership evidence is the insurer's 1946 founding capital (62 per cent Peruvian, 38 per cent Bolivian businesspeople), which does not establish who owned it when the official worked there, and the bank in the same record is state-linked. LBY refused on the Brimmer precedent: a move out to work as one's own private economic consultant, for the IMF among others, is not a move through private finance; it is logged, not filed. BTN dropped: fiti.bt/staff/dasho-penjore/ returns 404 and could not be opened, so the record has no readable source. It was a public move and costs no place; a working source for the Royal Monetary Authority governor's career would restore it.
